availability.note: GAC Australia spec/price page (gacgroup.com/en-au) serves two grades, Premium and Luxury, each with a salePrice; the model page links to a live drive-away price builder; theBeep lists both grades with Victorian drive-away prices on 2026-11-27

listPrice.note: GAC AU page data: vehModelName 'Premium' salePrice 42590, shown under the site's 'Base MSRP' label (manufacturer's own figure; the page's drive-away figure is a separate postcode-based calculator). CarExpert (18 Nov 2025, https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-news/2026-gac-aion-v-price-and-specs) gives $42,590 under 'Price before on-road costs' in words, and CarExpert's 6 Sep 2026 review repeats it. Direction check: theBeep Victorian drive-away $46,180 sits $921 above the app's computed VIC drive-away $45,258.78, so the list price is genuine (gap ~ dealer delivery, same on both grades). CarsGuide's '$47,990 Luxury' lead not reproduced: its page showed $44,590 MSRP but also a 7yr warranty and 75.20kWh, so that record was discarded

batteryKwh.note: usable: EV Database lists nominal 78.0 kWh, useable 75.3 kWh for the same 510km WLTP variant; GAC AU page lists 'Battery Capacity(kWh) 75.26' unlabelled, which matches the usable figure

rangeKm.note: GAC AU page '510（WLTP）' on the 19-inch wheel both grades ship on; EV Database UK lists 317 mi (510 km) WLTP for the same variant

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: GAC AU page 'Vehicle Consumption-combined（kWh/100km） 16.7（WLTP）'; EV Database 269 Wh/mi = 16.7; battery/range = 14.8, within tolerance (WLTP figure includes charging losses)

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: GAC AU page 'Rear Trunk Space (L) 427-978'; CarExpert gives 427L seats up. Measurement method (to cover vs roof) not stated; no frunk (EV Database frunk 0 L)

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: GAC AU page 427-978; CarExpert 978L rear seats folded. Method not stated; the low folded figure suggests a belt-line measurement

towKg.note: EV Database: braked towing 0 kg, tow hitch not possible; GAC AU spec page lists no towing figure; EV Central says GAC has not published one

warrantyYears.note: GAC AU warranty T&Cs (Aug 2026): '8 Year Unlimited Kilometre Warranty - Electrical Vehicle' other than commercial use; GAC 'does not require you to perform all service or repairs at a GAC Authorised Service Dealer', so not servicing-conditional. Commercial EV use 5 yr/150,000 km; traction battery 8 yr/200,000 km private

insuranceAnnual.note: held value kept after re-anchoring: byd-atto3-evo-premium $1,700 at $46,990, leapmotor-c10-style $1,700 at $45,888, byd-sealion-7-premium $1,650 at $54,990, geely-ex5 $1,600/$1,700; Luxury $50 above Premium for the $2,000 price step

depreciationCurve.note: one GAC brand curve [1, 0.7, 0.58, 0.49, 0.42, 0.36], identical to gac-aion-ut: steeper than mainstream for a brand new to Australia (launched Dec 2025) with thin dealer network and no resale history, plus ongoing $2,000 cashback on the Premium (theBeep, 20 May-31 Dec 2026); sits just below leapmotor-c10's new-brand curve
